title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a technique used to convert categorical variables into a form that could be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. It creates binary columns for each category. Can you think of how this might apply to the cluster numbers?

title: Why One-Hot Encode?
text: Consider how machine learning models interpret numerical values. If you leave the cluster numbers as they are, the model might assume a numerical relationship between them. What could be a better way to represent these clusters?

text: What is the best way to handle categorical data like cluster numbers before training a model?
